before: __construct runs when an object is created. Constructor property promotion combines a parameter and a property declaration: public string $title declares the property and assigns the supplied argument before the constructor body.
A default parameter value is used when the argument is omitted. It does not permanently force that value after construction. $this refers to the current instance inside its non-static methods.
